messages:
riley: Quick sync: users are reporting confusion between client timeouts and server Retry-After in the error reference. The examples across SDK pages are inconsistent (ms vs seconds vs idiomatic Go). Can we standardize the quickstarts?

mira: I think standardizing the copy/paste examples to `timeout_ms` is the cleanest for HTTP/JS/Python. For Go we should keep `context.WithTimeout` but add an explicit mapping comment.

ken: Agreed. Also found the streaming examples have different cancel behavior notes. We should add a short paragraph explaining that client timeouts abort the local stream read (and may still allow server token generation to finish), whereas Retry-After is guidance for retries.

riley: Good call. Action plan: mira updates snippets and errref table; ken will add the streaming cancellation caveat; sam will run snippet-lint and link-check after changes.

docs-bot: docs-bot: Created PR template checklist: [ ] unify snippets to `timeout_ms`, [ ] add Go mapping comment, [ ] add streaming cancel caveat, [ ] update errref conversion table, [ ] run snippet-lint and link-check.

mira: Opened PR WIP: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2350. Replaced mixed params in quickstarts, added an "Interpreting timeouts" subsection in errref, and inserted a tiny conversion table: `timeout_ms: 3000` -> `timeout_seconds=3` (Python) -> `context.WithTimeout(ctx, 3*time.Second)` (Go).

sam: Running snippet-lint now. Two failures: one streaming example still uses `deadlineMs` in an embedded Gist, and one shell quickstart has an old `--timeout-secs` flag. I'll patch both in the PR review.

ken: I'll drop a short streaming paragraph into the errref: "Client abort vs server Retry-After: cancelling a client request (timeout) stops local processing; server Retry-After indicates when a client should retry — they are not interchangeable."

mira: Thanks. Also added a small migration note under the quickstart: "If you previously used seconds, multiply by 1000 for `timeout_ms`. Server Retry-After remains in seconds per HTTP spec."

riley: Target merge by Monday. If link-checker flags any cross-references to SDK param names, please update those links to the SDK reference (or add a mapping comment).

docs-bot: docs-bot: PR #2350 updated  link-check queued. Snippet-lint: in-progress.
